newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Horana seen boosting Sri Lanka turnover.
newsitem.headline: Horana seen boosting Sri Lanka turnover.

text.p: Sri Lankan stocks are seen remaining flat with the sale of a parcel of 1.7 million Horana Plantations at 24 rupees, introduced on Monday on an all-or-none basis, expected to boost turnover, brokers said on Wednesday.
"It will probably be a dull, flat day today," said Rajiv Casiechitty, manager of research at CT Smith Stock Brokers.
"People are just waiting because of the holidays. This is the last full week of trading for the year."
The Colombo Stock Exchange all share price index closed 1.31 down at 589.97 on Tuesday on turnover of 12.3 million rupees on 317,334 shares. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319

"There's nothing much other than the Horana parcel," said Prasanna Chandrasekera, a trader specialising in retail investors at brokerage John Keells. "Most foreign fund managers are not in their seats. Retailers are also out of action."

The parcel of 1.7 million Horana Plantations at 24 rupees, introduced on Monday on an all-or-none basis, remains on offer. The quantity which is being held for three days, will be concluded on Wednesday. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
